# Cines Renoir

> > Cines Renoir is a cinema chain operating multiple theaters in Madrid and Barcelona, offering independent and arthouse films with online ticketing, Club Renoir membership benefits, and promotional programs.

The official website for Cines Renoir provides information about their theater locations (including Renoir Plaza de España, Renoir Retiro, Renoir Floridablanca, and Cines Princesa), ticket purchasing through pillalas.com, membership programs, and customer support. Operated by GESTION INTEGRAL MULTISALAS, S.L., the site complies with GDPR and Spanish data protection regulations.

## Key Topics

- Cines Renoir theater chain
- Club Renoir membership program
- Online ticket purchasing (pillalas.com)
- Madrid cinema locations (Plaza de España, Retiro)
- Barcelona cinema locations (Floridablanca)
- Cines Princesa
- Promotional discounts and codes
- VUELVE AL CINE promotion
- Gift card redemption
- Newsletter subscription
- GDPR compliance (Reglamento UE 2016/679)
- Spanish data protection (LOPDGDD)
- FAQ and customer support
- Advance ticket booking
